name: the-folded-atlas
description: A high-fidelity interactive 3D paper pop-up storybook, designed for web, iOS and Android.

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/engine/Book.js && node --check src/engine/AudioEngine.js && node --check src/scene/LanternGateScene.js && node --check src/scene/PaperPuppet.js && node --check vite.config.js
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
